posts.title: Mzuzu Executive Summit 2026: Building Sustainable Urban Growth
posts.author: Mayor's Office
posts.body: The Mayor of Mzuzu City hosted civil leaders to outline urban development projects aimed at transforming Mzuzu into a vibrant economic hub by 2030 through strategic planning, community engagement, and robust infrastructure development programs across all city wards.

posts.title: City-Wide Food & Maize Distribution Initiative
posts.author: Social Welfare
posts.body: Mzuzu City Council initiates targeted maize distribution across local wards to bolster household food security and support vulnerable families during lean periods.

posts.title: Upgrading M5 Transit & Drainage Networks
posts.author: Engineering
posts.body: Engineering directorate launches infrastructural upgrades along major city roads to enhance safety, improve transportation of goods, and prevent rainy season flooding.

directorates.name: Directorate of Education
directorates.desc: Manages public primary school infrastructure, supports Early Childhood Development (ECD) centers, and coordinates adult literacy and youth educational programs across all city wards to foster academic growth and lifelong learning opportunities.

directorates.name: Directorate of Planning
directorates.desc: Oversees town planning schemes, processes building development applications, conducts site inspections, and enforces physical development guidelines to ensure orderly and sustainable urban expansion.

directorates.name: Directorate of Commerce & Trade
directorates.desc: Facilitates business licensing, manages central and ward markets, allocates vendor spaces, and supports local economic development initiatives for traders and entrepreneurs.

directorates.name: Directorate of Engineering
directorates.desc: Leads public infrastructure development, road repairs, storm-water drainage construction, street lighting maintenance, and municipal fleet upkeep.

forms.title: Business License Application Form (Form BL-1)
forms.desc: Required for initial registration and annual renewal of business premises in Mzuzu City.

forms.title: Development & Building Permit Application (Form BP-2)
forms.desc: For individuals and developers seeking structural plan review and building approval.

about.title: Mandate & Governance
about.content: Mzuzu City Council is a corporate body established under the Local Government Act of 1998. The Council is tasked with managing municipal affairs, urban planning, infrastructure maintenance, public health, and basic education delivery in Mzuzu City.

about.title: Vision & Mission
about.content: Vision: A vibrant, clean, prosperous, and sustainable city by 2030. Mission: To deliver accessible, quality municipal services and facilitate socio-economic development through good governance and active civic participation.
